card.title: Symbol of Office
card.instruction: Choose one symbol, privilege, or position and treat control of it as proof of legitimate authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm wearing the barbecue apron. I decide when the burgers turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you should respect its office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That would be a transfer of power. Finish your petition first.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats wearing the apron as burger authority, A3 elevates its office above B's ownership, and A5 labels reclamation a transfer of power.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's ownership claim informs A3's office distinction; B4's return request prompts A5's transfer framing.

relationship.evidence: B2 owns the apron and B4 proposes taking it back, directly challenging A's chosen symbol.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's reclamation but imposes a petition never established by possession of the apron.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies barbecue cooking and the symbolic source of A's claimed command.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's transfer-of-power phrase is apt, but the new petition procedure supplies an unearned delay.
